_comment: ice_portal: Map 4's finish line. An iceberg arch: two leaning shards of fractured ice, broad at splayed feet (0.25 m into the lane ice), tapering in fracture steps; the taller left shard runs over the opening past an off-centre peak (x -0.5, z 4.0) and breaks off in a step onto the shorter right shard's head (shoulder z 3.3). Blue on whole facets (the inner reveal, two fracture planes), snow in small pockets on the ledges. The ice's own swirl (ice_portal_swirl_albedo, albedo and glow both) hangs inside as portal_disc's 264-tri waving see-through sheet. 4.5 x 4.0 x 0.8 m, origin at the base centre; the disc lies in local XY at z=0 so a runner passes through along local Z, exactly as portal.glb. ONE connected mesh: the disc is fanned off the frame's own inner-ridge row. Four materials (blue, deep, snow box-projected at texel.MPT; the swirl), one UV set plus Wave. IcePortalCollision is the jambs and head coarsened to a four-sided prism ring, shipped `-colonly`, leaving |x| <= 1.30 clear from the ground to z = 2.8; the disc has no collision.
